exceptions.evidence: docs/planning/04-visual-interaction-spec.md section 6 defines exact triggers, duration ranges, reduced-motion behavior, the static warning-border substitute for F, domMax ownership for C layout components, and a zero-ambient-loop rule for every class.

notes: The typeface limit is project-owned at two: Space Grotesk for Latin brand display and Noto Sans JP for Japanese UI and body text.
The six type roles are display, page title, section title, subheading, body or emphasis, and caption or metadata.

Spacing was evaluated as content gap, section gap, and page-container padding at the existing 768px breakpoint. The 1440px and 390px onboarding renders preserve grouping without horizontal page overflow.
The single dominant grammar is a vertically ordered task or analysis flow containing responsive shelves, cards, and record groups; column-count changes do not create a second grammar.
The three surface styles are page paper, raised bordered content, and temporarily elevated raised content.

Status color --warn is not counted as an accent. --accent-hover is a darker state in the same hue and chroma family, not a second accent. Authentic manga covers are product evidence, not a decorative image family.
System Chrome measured white/accent at 4.888:1, white/accent-hover at 6.078:1, accent/paper at 4.560:1, and accent/accent-soft at 4.561:1 after review integration.

Repeated 28px and 24px section uses now consume existing spacing primitives. Only fixed-UI obstruction roles received new semantics: safe area, mobile navigation clearance, onboarding tray clearance, and taste fixed-action clearance.
